title: •Han’s Toolkit
caption: •Han’s Toolkit (V)
game_text: Deploy on _Falcon_ or Han. While Han piloting _Falcon_ at a battleground, non-{alter} Effects (except Emperor’s Power, Presence Of The Force, and Search And Destroy) are suspended.
lore: Experienced pilots keep a well equipped toolkit. Horizontal boosters, alluvial dampers and hydrospanners aid in performing high-tech repairs aboard starships.

notes: Unique. Green Device frame, banner DEVICE. 'Falcon' italic twice; inline red circle-slash A after 'non-' → non-{alter} (stub 'non-(Immune to Alter)'); curly apostrophes in Han’s / Emperor’s. The wiki's default 'Han's Toolkit' page carries Glossary Supplement errata text; printed face = 'Han's Toolkit (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-L-hanstoolkit.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs11/06-Dagobah-L-hanstoolkit.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
